subject: Prepay invoicing and revenue recognition for 3-year commitment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Winters <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>, finance@brightlinehealth.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prepay invoicing and revenue recognition for 3-year commitment

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we finalize the 3-year prepaid commitment for Brightline, Finance asked me to confirm Brightline's preferred invoicing cadence so we can align on revenue recognition and the billing schedule. A couple of things we want to be clear on:

- You mentioned wanting invoices aligned to your fiscal years — do you prefer we issue three separate annual invoices (one per contract year) even though the payment is prepaid up front, or would you rather a single upfront invoice that we mark as prepaid?
- Do you need PO numbers on each invoice or a single PO referencing the whole commitment?
- Any internal requirements around invoice dates (e.g., must be dated within the fiscal year for expense recognition)?

High level options from our side:
1) Single upfront invoice for the full amount at signature (simplest from invoicing). We would recognize revenue ratably over the 36 months per ASC 606.
2) Split invoicing: issue three invoices dated at contract start and at each 12-month anniversary (or dated to your fiscal year cutoffs). Payment terms would still reflect the prepay structure (we can accept payment up front or schedule annual payments).

If you prefer option 2, please confirm the target invoice dates for years 1–3 and any PO numbers. I’ve looped in Lauren (Finance) and Avery (Sales Ops) to provide the rev-rec guidance and to draft the invoice schedule.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it’s easier.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sarah Winters <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>

Cc: finance@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:37:42 -0400
Subject: Re: Prepay invoicing and revenue recognition for 3-year commitment

Thanks Karthik —

We do prefer invoices that align to our fiscal year for budgeting and expense recognition. Our FY runs Apr 1–Mar 31. For a 3-year prepay we would like three invoices that map to each FY window if possible:

- Year 1: Invoice dated 2026-04-01 covering Apr 1, 2026–Mar 31, 2027
- Year 2: Invoice dated 2027-04-01 covering Apr 1, 2027–Mar 31, 2028
- Year 3: Invoice dated 2028-04-01 covering Apr 1, 2028–Mar 31, 2029

We can provide a PO that references the full three-year commitment; however, our procurement team prefers separate invoice numbers for each fiscal year. We can push the payment for year 1 up front once we have the invoice dated 2026-04-01 and the DocuSign executed.

Two questions from me: will the multi-year term discount be applied to each invoice equally, and from a rev-rec standpoint will Redwood record the full amount as deferred revenue and recognize ratably?

Sarah Winters
Director of Finance
Brightline Health

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Winters <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>, finance@brightlinehealth.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prepay invoicing and revenue recognition for 3-year commitment

Sarah —

Perfect, thanks for the clarity on fiscal windows. I’ll coordinate with Finance to model the three invoice dates you listed. Quick answers before Lauren jumps in:

- Discounting: the negotiated multi-year term discount (15% for BL-3487) would be applied pro rata across the three invoices — we will not apply additional year-over-year escalations unless we documented them in the SOW.
- Rev-rec: yes, our accounting treats prepaid multi-year contracts as deferred revenue that we amortize/recognize over the service period; I’ll let Lauren confirm the precise schedule and wording.

Next steps: Lauren, can you confirm whether Redwood can issue three invoices dated 2026-04-01, 2027-04-01, 2028-04-01, and whether Brightline needs the invoices to be present-dated to those exact days for your auditors? Also tagging Neha for any standard contract language we should include around invoicing and discount application.

Karthik

---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Winters <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>, finance@brightlinehealth.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:32:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Prepay invoicing and revenue recognition for 3-year commitment

Hi all —

Thanks for the details. Redwood can accommodate split invoicing tied to Brightline’s fiscal year windows. A few practical items and our recommended approach:

1) Invoicing approach
   - We will prepare three invoices that reflect the discounted amounts for each year. Each invoice will have its own invoice number.
   - To match your request, we can date the Year 1 invoice 2026-04-01, Year 2 invoice 2027-04-01, and Year 3 invoice 2028-04-01. If Brightline will remit Year 1 payment up front, we will mark the Year 1 invoice as paid and record the remainder as prepaid/credit on our books until subsequent invoice dates arrive.

2) Revenue recognition (high level)
   - Per ASC 606, Redwood will record cash received as deferred revenue and recognize it ratably over the 36-month service period.
   - If Brightline prefers three dated invoices but pays the full amount on Day 1, our internal treatment will still be deferred revenue; the invoice dates will not change the underlying recognition pattern (we can provide a schedule showing the monthly amortization).

3) Discount application and allocation
   - Multi-year discount will be applied pro rata across the three invoices. There are no additional volume/usage skews in this deal, so a straight allocation by contract value is appropriate.

4) PO and audit notes
   - We recommend the PO reference the overall agreement and include invoice-specific PO lines (e.g., PO# BL-PO-917 — Invoice Year 1, Invoice Year 2, Invoice Year 3). That keeps things clean for both teams.

I’ve attached a short model (revrec_calculation.xlsx) that shows the deferred revenue schedule and the monthly recognition amounts under both the single-invoice and split-invoice scenarios. If Brightline’s auditors require present-dating to a fiscal year cutoff, please confirm and we can rubber-stamp the invoice dates accordingly.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

- Audit: We prefer the invoices to be dated on the FY cut dates (2026-04-01, 2027-04-01, 2028-04-01). We will remit Year 1 payment immediately after the DocuSign is complete.

Also: do you have a DocuSign link we can sign? If there are any routing notes that will push invoice dates past Apr 1, please call them out.

Sarah
